lines.zh: 蹄子踩在湿泥里，咕叽作响。
lines.en: My hooves squelch through the wet mud.
I trot along with my snout to the ground.

lines.zh: 皮上长了硬鳞，走路磨得响。
lines.en: Hard scales have grown on my hide and rasp as I walk.
I walk past the pen and head into the village.

lines.zh: 这四条腿跑起来比我记的快。
lines.en: These legs run faster than I remember.
I snort as I go.
Muddy water runs down my back.

lines.zh: 我贴着小路边的篱笆走。
lines.en: I walk along the fence beside the path.
My prints sink deep and will last in the mud.
I smell iron and smoke.
I quicken my pace. My belly is empty.
Bootsteps ahead of me.
I root through a bush.

lines.zh: 蹄子陷进泥里，我照旧往前。
lines.en: My hooves sink in the mud; still I go on.
Wet sand packs into the gaps of my hooves.

lines.zh: 我从水沟里爬上来，抖了抖。
lines.en: I climb out of the ditch and shake.
I stand and my snout twitches.

lines.zh: 嘴边长出了不该有的牙齿。
lines.en: Teeth have grown where they should not be.

lines.zh: 我低头看着泥里的自己。
lines.en: I lower my head and look at myself in the mud.
My belly rumbles with a strange sound.

lines.zh: 我不再爱吃那些烂果子。
lines.en: I no longer care for rotten fruit.
I listen to the villagers talking.
My hide has hardened another layer.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子探进水里，又抬起。
lines.en: I dip my snout in water, then lift it.
There is meat on the wind.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经不听使唤了。
lines.en: My tail no longer answers me.

lines.zh: 我蹭了蹭篱笆，木头松了。
lines.en: I rub the fence and the wood gives.
I remember this village.
I sniff at the fence, breathing hard.
The sun is dry; the mud is nearly hot.
You are standing in front of my meal.
Do not put your hand on me.

lines.zh: 你身上有猪圈和火的味道。
lines.en: You smell of pigpen and fire.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的鳃，我有点烦。
lines.en: You stare at my gills; it irritates me.
Gills have opened in this pig face.

lines.zh: 你的靴子看起来很好吃。
lines.en: Your boots look edible.
My snout moves because I am smelling you.
Is anyone behind you?
These teeth are quite new.
Do not run. If you run, I chase.
The hide is thick, but that still hurt.

lines.zh: 海嗣化的猪，蹄子都变了。
lines.en: A seaborn pig — even my hooves changed.

lines.zh: 我原来是猪，现在是海嗣。
lines.en: I was a pig. Now I am a seaborn.
Two steps back, then I push in again.

lines.zh: 这一下让我忘了要吃什么。
lines.en: That made me forget what I wanted to eat.

lines.zh: 鼻子里喷出血沫，我退了退。
lines.en: Bloody foam spurts from my snout; I back off.
The wound is closing, slowly.
I shake and blood drips into the mud.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我獠牙发麻。
lines.en: The blow leaves my tusks numb.
It is not time for me to fall.
Is that what they feed pigs?
I smell bran and yams.
I put my head down and eat. No ceremony.
This tastes better than mud.
Another inch with that hand and I bite.
I knock the bucket over.
I used to eat more than this.
This trough is too small.
I chew with one eye still on you.
I eat it and I am still hungry.
That knock stung my hide.
Keep off my tusks.

lines.zh: 我身上的泥比你想象的硬。
lines.en: The mud on my hide is harder than you think.
You stepped on my hoof.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙擦过你的护腿。
lines.en: My tusks graze your leggings.
I rammed you and you stumbled back.

lines.zh: 你的靴尖顶到我的鼻子。
lines.en: Your boot tip pokes my snout.
My hide is all mud. Do not wipe it.
If you want past, pass quickly.
Bump me again and I stop being polite.

lines.zh: 圈里那些同类，都不认我了。
lines.en: The pigs in the pen do not know me.
They retreat to the corner.

lines.zh: 我记得从前挤在一起取暖。
lines.en: I remember huddling together for warmth.
Now when I come close they squeal.

lines.zh: 还有一只也变了，在村外。
lines.en: One more changed. Out past the village.
We lie side by side in the mud.
It does not eat rotten fruit either.
Neither of us touches the other.
This much company will do.
At night we walk together.
I root out a yam and eat it.
A piece of meat on the ground. Good.
I take up a strip of cloth.
A bone. I gnaw it a bit.
Iron scrap in the mud. I push it aside.

lines.zh: 我把东西埋进泥里藏着。
lines.en: I bury it in the mud for later.
This shiny thing. I carry it off.
I got a mouthful of mud.

lines.zh: 掉下来的果子，我全吃了。
lines.en: Fallen fruit. I eat every bit.
I never turn down more.

lines.zh: 那个铁做的东西走过来了。
lines.en: That iron thing is walking this way.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子早一步闻到了。
lines.en: My nose caught it a beat early.
He stands alone at the field edge.
I lower my head and edge forward.
What he holds catches the light.
Nobody else is near.
I have fixed on his legs.
The pen fence will not hold me.
He turned. Just the moment.
I plant my hooves.
I trot a circle around him.
He steps back; I step in.
My head stays down.
Mud makes no sound.
He is looking for a way out.
The fence has cut off one side of him.
Two steps closer.
His breathing is quick.
I wait for him to lift a foot.

lines.zh: 篱笆挡不住我这四条腿。
lines.en: The fence won't stop these four legs.
Head down, I ram his knee.
My tusk rips his trouser leg.
I clamp down on his arm.
My hoof comes down on his instep.

lines.zh: 这一撞把他推倒在泥里。
lines.en: The charge drops him into the mud.
I butt him away.

lines.zh: 他躲了第一下，没躲第二下。
lines.en: He dodged once, not twice.

lines.zh: 牙齿在他身上留下了印。
lines.en: My teeth left marks on him.
I lie on him. I am heavy.
He rolls away and I follow a step.
I rise out of the mud.

lines.zh: 这身皮已经不是猪皮了。
lines.en: This hide is no longer a pig's hide.
I shake and clods of mud fly.

lines.zh: 猪圈的门开着，我走出去。
lines.en: The pen gate is open. I walk out.
The village smells different now.
Head down, I look for food first.

lines.zh: 这具身体比我原来的大。
lines.en: This body is bigger than my old one.

lines.zh: 我看见自己的影子，认不出来。
lines.en: I see my shadow and do not know it.
My hooves press into fresh mud.

lines.zh: 猪圈的木头味里，多了铁。
lines.en: The pigpen's wood smell now carries iron.
Fire found my hide and I rolled in the mud.
I slid down the bank and landed heavy.
Muddy water fills my snout and I thrash.
The blast threw me into the pen.

lines.zh: 箭尾还在抖，我扭头去咬。
lines.en: The arrow's fletching quivers; I turn to bite it.
Strange light burns under my hide.

lines.zh: 什么都没有，我开始咬木头。
lines.en: Nothing left to eat. I start chewing wood.

lines.zh: 雷劈在泥里，从我蹄子传上来。
lines.en: Lightning struck the mud and climbed my hooves.
The mud floor gave way and I fell.
